chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza, from Sufyan ibn Al-Simt, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the time for the Asr prayer on the day of Friday, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'It is in a time similar to the Dhuhr prayer on other than the day of Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What is the time for Asr prayer on Friday according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the Asr prayer on Friday is performed at the same time as Dhuhr, a ruling derived from the principle that the Friday congregational prayer (Salat al-Jumu'ah) substitutes for Dhuhr, thereby shifting the Asr time to coincide with it. This hadith highlights the jurisprudential nuance in Shia fiqh where the Friday prayer does not merely add to the daily prayers but alters the temporal structure of the midday prayers, ensuring the Asr prayer is not delayed until the late afternoon as it is on other days.
